zh-CN.title: 清迈四天：每天一个重点，剩下的交给咖啡和树影
zh-CN.excerpt: 老城、手作、山里和空白下午，不用把每座寺庙都变成待办。
zh-CN.content:
Day 1｜住在老城边缘
选择步行方便但不正对最热闹街道的位置。

Day 2｜寺庙与一段长午休
上午只看一座寺庙，最热的时候回去休息。

Day 3｜做一件能带走的东西
参加一次手作，或去一间真正喜欢的工作室。

Day 4｜去山里换空气
只选一个城外方向，减少沿途停靠点。

en.title: Four days in Chiang Mai: one focus a day, then coffee and shade
en.excerpt: Old city, craft, the hills and an empty afternoon—without turning every temple into a task.
en.content:
Day 1 | Stay at the old-city edge
Choose somewhere walkable without facing the busiest street.

Day 2 | One temple and a long midday break
Visit in the morning and rest through the heat.

Day 3 | Make something you can carry home
Join one craft session or visit a studio you genuinely like.

Day 4 | Change the air in the hills
Choose one direction outside town and reduce the stops.
